text:
Simone Vega: hey folks!! first day — hi from SF :wave: i'm Simone (she/they), ex-community-eng + weekend sourdough dad. desk 2B-03. excited about the rooftop playlists and trivia nights.
Benji: welcome Simone!! :tada: bring sourdough to the next happy hour and we'll trade playlist recs.
Priya: hi hi, onboarding buddy here. badge pickup is at facilities after 2pm. i'll ping you for a quick tour.
Facilities: Package for Simone Vega arrived and is at desk 2B-03. Badge pickup available at desk 1 after 2pm.
Simone Vega: thanks Priya & Facilities — will grab badge after lunch. quick q: anyone know where the best power outlet is for an action-packed laptop + fermenter setup?
Noel: 2B near the window has a good outlet strip. just don't plug the proofing box into the coffee machine :grimacing:
Sammy: pro tip: #foodies channel has a weekly bake-off sign-up — highly recommend. also we keep a stash of emergency cinnamon at bench C.
Priya: also welcome-bot reminder: don't forget to join #rooftop-spotify and #trivia. new hire lunch tomorrow 12:30 — RSVP in calendar.
welcome-bot: Reminder: complete your security training and join #new-hires-welcome. Orientation at 3:00 PM.
Simone Vega: will do all of the above. also i have a terrible sourdough pun: "i've loafed you from the very first crumb." i'll add it to #random. thanks for the warm welcome :heart:
